why: A May 2024 arXiv paper by Hales and Vajjha ('Packings of Smoothed Polygons') claims a proof of Mahler's First conjecture, that an extreme centrally-symmetric convex domain must be a smoothed polygon; this narrows the class of candidate minimizers but does not identify the minimizer as the smoothed octagon, so it is unclear whether this counts as a case of Reinhardt's conjecture being settled or a related-but-distinct result.
